notes.title: v0.94 Update!
notes.notes: [h3][b]3 New Commanders[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Ratkin Infiltrator[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ancient Toad[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Treant Elder[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The [b]Ratkin Cheiftain[/b] has a new Commander Ability, [b]Cruel Motivation.[/b][/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Spell Selection Rework[/b] [/p][p]Spells are now free, and spellcasters can choose 2 spells. One "Cantrip", minor spell and one "Major Spell". Some hybrid spellcasters only have access to cantrips. All spellcasters have gone up 10 points in cost. The idea behind this change is that spellcaster should be versatile, and having multiple spell options to choose from in battle makes for more interesting gameplay. The current system where each spell costs points often made the optimal choice be to just play a single powerful spell.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Until End of Turn Effects[/b] [/p][p]All spells and abilities that last until end if turn have been changed to last "for one turn". This means they expire at the start of the next Strategic phase instead. The only impact of this is that movement spells now affect charge moves. Abilities like "Full Steam" and "Hunters Call " should be more attractive, and the charge range display in strategic phase is actually accurate![/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance Changes[/b] [/p][p]Goatmen have continued to over-perform a bit. Feral Giants [b]Boulder Throw[/b] is reduced to 15 points but is now single use. Mongrel skirmishers no longer have Hand Weapons. Raiding Chariots are now capped to max 2 in Warband.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Scoring Objectives Change[/b][/p][p]Objectives no longer score on turn 1.[/p][p]Single model units can no longer claim scoring objectives. Flying units can, but only if they are not single models![/p]

notes.title: v0.77 Update!
notes.notes:
Version 0.77 is out with a bunch och new stuff:

[b]Campaign Changes[/b]
Spacebar fast forward is now a bit faster, from 2x speed to 2.5x
Elites give 2x Coins up from 1.5x

New Commander ability for Elven Noble - Rallying Cry. Instantly rally a fleeing unit. One use per Battle.
[b]

New Units[/b]

Imperial Dreadnought - It's a tank!
Dragon Knights - Elite heavy cavalry for Elven Conclaves. Can go head to head with the best!
Jungle Swarms - A slithering tar pit unit for the Reptilians.

[b]
New faction[/b]

[b]
Balance Changes[/b]

notes.title: v0.74 Update!
notes.notes:
New Commander for the Goatmen : [b]Minotaur King [/b]
Only rolls with a Minotaur retinue and hits like a truck! Frenzy and an activated ability:  Blood Rage.

Units can now [b]flee as a reaction to being Charged[/b]. It works as a normal action during the charge phase, mouse over a charged unit to activate. The rules for being allowed to flee from a charge is:
[list]
[*] Only charged by one unit.
[*] No Frenzy
[*] No Reanimated
[*] Enough Move Speed to get out of charge range.
[/list]

[b]Commanders now survive losing their retinue[/b]. Overkill wounds on the retinue does carry over. Commanders on solo Mounts like a chariot or dragon still die if the mount dies!

[h3]Campaign Changes[/h3]

There is now a [b]global difficulty unlock level for Campaign[/b].  It's based on total amount of difficulties completed between all Commanders/Factions and will gradually unlock up to level 4.

[b]One random unit in Armory is now discounted by 25%[/b]. Adds some extra strategy and hopefully variety in unit purchases.

[b]New level ups for the Reptilians[/b]
Jaguar Aspect - +1 Move Speed and ignores difficult terrain. 
Raptor Aspect - Deadly Attacks (double wounds).
Serpent Aspect - Poisoned Attacks
Salamander Aspect - Regeneration
Eagle Aspect - +5 ranged attack range
Turtle Aspect - re-roll 1s on Damage Saves.

[b]Level ups for Orcs[/b]
Bloodlust: Activated ability, +1 Attack and fearless for one turn.
Won't stay down: Passive Replenish Bonus.
Tough as Nails. Rerolls 1s on Damage Saves.

[b]Level ups for Goblins[/b]
Strength in Numbers: Model Count +10.
Backstabbers: Re-roll Attack Rolls when attacking Flank/Rear
Goblin Greed: +10 loot

[b]Greater Warcry[/b] level up for commanders with Warcry. Also give +2 Move Speed to all units. 

[b]Frost Ward[/b] and [b]Shroud [/b]both have upgraded version as well.

New spell added, [b]Shroud[/b]. This gives a uni the Cover effect until it's next combat phase, making it harder to hit with ranged weapons.

notes.title: v0.51 Update: Competitive and UX
notes.notes:
0.51 is out, lots of stuff!
 
[list]
[*] [b]2 new units.[/b] The [b]Doom Bell[/b] is a mount for Ratkin Warlocks. The sound of the bell sends your rats into a murderous frenzy! Dead Nations get a [b]Zombie Giant[/b]. It's a giant zombie. Yup.
[*] [b]Timers in multiplayer[/b]. Players now have limited time to complete deployment and unit activations. Pretty generous, 2 mins per activation and 4 mins for Deployment. May be changed based on feedback!
[*] [b]Equal Activations[/b]: Both players now have equal amount of activations in the strategic phase. If you have fewer units than your opponent you can use your extra activations to "Pass" the turn. This strategic advantage should make smaller, elite armies more viable!
[*] [b]Updated Scoring[/b] for multiplayer: you now also gain points for units at half strength.
[*] Some [b]AI improvements[/b] and fixes. Most notably the AI should be much better at actually moving units into charge range, avoiding obstacles.
[*] [b]Cover system[/b] changes. Cover now affects ranged attacks from warmachines as well, reducing the number of hits by one (per die). "Protected Crew" and the "Banner of Mist" both give units permanent Cover effect.
[*] Option to [b]"undo" unit activations[/b] if you change your mind before doing anything
[*] [b]Spacebar[/b] now advances the game in all phases. If you still have actions left to perform you need to hit spacebar twice to confirm, to avoid accidentally ending a phase.
[*] [b]Balance tweaks[/b]: Flying mounts and Chariots have had some points tweaks. All Warmachines and Chariots are now at 5 wounds. Ratkin Longrifles up to Skill 4. 
[*] Lots of bug fixes!
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.17
notes.notes:
[b]Visual Stuff[/b]
 [list]
[*] Units look a little fancier, and each faction has a unique look. Orcs are dirty, undead tattered and broken, elves fancy with golden borders, dwarves with a stony texture and so on...
[*] Units get bloodied when they kill a lot of dudes.
[*] Arrows stick around in the ground forever now.
[/list]
[b]Naming[/b]
 [list]
[*] Units and commanders can be given names in the army editor and campaign.
[*] Units and commanders have random name generators, new units will get named automatically. 
[/list]
[b]UI Tweaks[/b]
  [list]
[*]  A lot of UI has been reworked, especially in battle. This will probably take a while to get used to, but they definitely feel better to me after playing a while. Main things are:
[*]  The Event log has been cleaned up a lot. Only important information is shown, details have been moved to mouse overs.
[*]  The dice box (where you roll dice) has also been cleaned up.
[*]  Interface during combat has been changed a lot! Dice rolling is moved to the center, the combat score at the top is much clearer.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]  Should no longer freeze on post battle screen in campaign.
[*]  AI units will no longer try to target dead units. This led to some really weird movement behaviour.
[*]  AI units can now properly use the Army Wide buffs. Before they only targeted one unit.
[*]   A ton more!
[/list]
